Feature.Title: Get started with more sample Power Automate templates and Power Apps
Feature.description: Access multiple Power Automate templates and Power Apps to automate your business processes. This makes it easier to integrate and extend the functionality of Business Central, so you can save time and streamline tasks.

Feature.Title: Use business events to notify and trigger external systems
Feature.description: This feature allows you to use business events in Business Central to trigger notifications and actions in external systems. It improves the integration and automation of your workflows across platforms.

Feature.Title: Select a Dataverse environment used for actions based on Power Automate flows
Feature.description: You can now select a specific Dataverse environment to use for actions based on your Power Automate flows. This gives you greater flexibility and control over the data flow between Business Central and Dataverse.

Feature.Title: Use Power Automate to post adaptive card or link to Business Central record
Feature.description: This feature allows you to use Power Automate to send adaptive cards or direct links to Business Central records. It improves communication and provides quick access to relevant information from external systems.

Feature.Title: New approval workflow experience with Power Automate templates
Feature.description: Get an improved approval workflow using new Power Automate templates. This streamlines approval processes and makes it easier to adapt them to specific business needs.

Feature.Title: Turn off event-based sync for specific integration table mappings
Feature.description: You can now disable event-based synchronization for selected integration table mappings. This gives you more granular control over data synchronization, which can optimize performance and data handling.

Feature.Title: Connect to Dataverse despite different currencies
Feature.description: This feature enables connection to Dataverse even when there are different currencies in Business Central and Dataverse. It removes a previous barrier to integration and supports international business scenarios.

Feature.Title: Use realized gain or loss entries to reverse ledger entries
Feature.description: You can now use realized gain or loss entries to reverse general ledger entries. This provides increased flexibility in bookkeeping and helps to correct errors more efficiently.

Feature.Title: Add more columns to pages for better insight
Feature.description: Customize your pages by adding more columns, giving you a better overview and insight into your data. This improves your ability to analyze and make informed decisions right in the system.

Feature.Title: Avoid document number errors when you post item journals
Feature.description: This function helps to avoid errors in document numbers when you post material journals. This ensures greater data accuracy and reduces the need for manual correction, saving time and resources.

Feature.Title: Bin Code and Zone Code fields are dynamically shown on warehouse documents
Feature.description: The Location Code and Zone Code fields are now dynamically displayed on warehouse documents, improving visibility and efficiency in inventory management. This gives you faster access to important information.

Feature.Title: Catalog items use standard number series, can include in blanket sales orders
Feature.description: Catalog items using standard number ranges can now be included in frame sales orders. This simplifies the process of handling large orders and ensures consistency in your merchandise management.

Feature.Title: Define an invoice posting policy for various users
Feature.description: You can now define specific invoice posting policies for different users. This provides greater control and flexibility in the accounting process, ensuring compliance with internal guidelines.

Feature.Title: Define content of created warehouse documents with filters
Feature.description: Precisely define the content of created warehouse documents using filters. This improves the accuracy and relevance of your inventory documents, contributing to more efficient inventory management.

Feature.Title: Demo tool and data for warehouse and inventory scenarios
Feature.description: Access a demo tool and data specifically designed for warehouse and storage scenarios. This makes it easier to test and understand the system's functions before implementation.

Feature.Title: Easier to create opening balances for item tracked inventory
Feature.description: The process of creating opening balances for tracked inventory has been simplified. This reduces the time and effort required to initiate inventory management for new or existing items.

Feature.Title: Easier to set up price synchronization for Shopify
Feature.description: Setting up price sync with Shopify is now easier. This streamlines the integration between your Business Central solution and your Shopify web store, ensuring accurate pricing across platforms.

Feature.Title: Intercompany posting provides a one-stop-shop setup experience
Feature.description: Internal accounting now offers a unified setup experience that simplifies the configuration of transactions between different companies. This reduces complexity and improves efficiency.

Feature.Title: Navigate easier between warehouse and inventory documents
Feature.description: Navigating between warehouse and warehouse documents is now easier, improving usability and day-to-day efficiency. This provides faster access to related information.

Feature.Title: Post multiple transfer orders at the same time
Feature.description: You can now post multiple transfer orders simultaneously, streamlining the process and saving time. This is particularly useful for companies with large volumes of internal goods movements.

Feature.Title: Preview item journals and 20 other journals and documents before posting
Feature.description: Get a preview of goods journals and many other journals and documents before you post them. This helps catch errors and ensure accuracy before data is sent to finance.

Feature.Title: Review general ledger accounts faster
Feature.description: The review of financial accounts has been optimized so that you can work faster and more efficiently. This improves your ability to analyze financial data and keep an overview of the accounts.

Feature.Title: Set default dimensions on locations, inventory documents, and journals
Feature.description: You can now set default dimensions on locations, warehouse documents, and drafts. This simplifies data entry and ensures consistency in your sizing, improving reporting and analysis.

Feature.Title: Set up and sync master data across companies
Feature.description: It is now possible to set up and synchronize master data across several companies. This ensures uniformity in master data and simplifies the management of information in group structures.

Feature.Title: Ship and receive non-inventory items on warehouse documents
Feature.description: You can now send and receive non-stock items directly on warehouse documents. This extends the functionality of stock management and allows you to handle several types of goods in the same workflow.

Feature.Title: Shopify connector becomes extensible
Feature.description: The Shopify connector is now extensible, allowing you to customize and add functionality to suit your specific needs. This provides greater flexibility in the integration with your Shopify webshop.

Feature.Title: Undo transfer shipments
Feature.description: You can now undo transfer deliveries, allowing you to correct errors or change plans more flexibly. This contributes to a more robust and fail-safe warehouse management.

Feature.Title: Usability improvements to Financial Reporting pages
Feature.description: The usability of Financial Reporting pages has been improved, making it easier to navigate and generate financial reports. This contributes to a more intuitive and efficient reporting experience.

Feature.Title: Usability improves for item tracking codes visibility, creation of new entries
Feature.description: Improvements in the usability of item tracking codes make it easier to view, create and manage new records. This streamlines the item tracking process and ensures accuracy.

Feature.Title: Usability improves for transfer order select multiple items, mandatory fields
Feature.description: Ease of use for transfer orders has been improved, including the ability to select multiple items and handle mandatory fields. This simplifies the process of creating and processing transfer orders.

Feature.Title: Usability improves for warehouse, inventory, and tracking areas
Feature.description: Ease of use improvements for warehouse, storage and tracking areas make it easier to navigate and work with these features. This contributes to more efficient and intuitive inventory management.

Feature.Title: Use advanced warehouse functionality with minimal complexity
Feature.description: This feature allows you to use advanced repository functionality without increasing complexity. It simplifies advanced inventory management and makes it accessible to a wider range of users.

Feature.Title: Use enhanced mail merge with Word templates
Feature.description: Use improved mail merge with Word templates to generate documents more efficiently. This streamlines the creation of personalized documents and reduces manual work.

Feature.Title: Use statistical accounts to collect data for financial reports
Feature.description: This feature allows you to use statistical accounts to collect specific data for financial reports. This provides more detailed insight and flexibility in your reporting.

Feature.Title: Usability improves for Shopify Connector
Feature.description: The usability of the Shopify connector has been improved, making the integration and management of your Shopify webshop more intuitive. This ensures smoother operation and fewer errors.

Feature.Title: Use attachments from document lines while sending emails
Feature.description: You can now include attachments directly from document lines when sending emails. This simplifies communication and ensures that all relevant documents are attached without manual work.

Feature.Title: Synchronize returns and refunds from Shopify
Feature.description: Synchronization of returns and refunds from Shopify is now possible, providing a more complete and accurate view of transactions. This improves your accounting and customer service.

Feature.Title: Create and resume interactions using guided experience
Feature.description: This feature allows you to create and resume interactions using a guided experience. This streamlines the process and makes it easier to handle customer contact and business interactions.

Feature.Title: Copy links when posting general journals
Feature.description: You can now copy links when posting general drafts, simplifying referencing and tracking information. This improves data handling and traceability in your financial processes.

Feature.Title: Get more info about customer ledger entries when posting
Feature.description: Access more detailed information about customer postings directly during the posting process. This gives you better insight and control over debtor relationships and financial transactions.

Feature.Title: Drive sales with AI-generated product descriptions
Feature.description: This feature makes it possible to increase sales by using AI to generate product descriptions. It saves time and ensures engaging and optimized descriptions that appeal to customers.

Feature.Title: Bulk release of CZ documents - Czechia
Feature.description: This feature enables the mass release of CZ documents for the Czech Republic. It streamlines document handling and ensures compliance with local regulations for Czech companies.

Feature.Title: Find posted and non-posted CZ document lines in search - Czechia
Feature.description: You can now find both posted and non-posted CZ document lines via search in the Czech Republic. This improves traceability and provides quick access to relevant information, which is important for financial reporting.

Feature.Title: Modern Action Bar in CZ localization apps - Czechia
Feature.description: A modern action bar is introduced in CZ location apps for Czech Republic. This improves usability and the overall visual experience for users in the Czech Republic.

Feature.Title: New blanket purchase order report in CZ design - Czechia
Feature.description: A new frame purchase order report in CZ design is available for the Czech Republic. This provides improved reporting and overview of framework purchase orders, adapted to Czech standards.

Feature.Title: Replace VAT Date CZ with VAT Reporting Date - Czechia
Feature.description: The VAT date in the Czech Republic has been replaced with a VAT reporting date, ensuring correct and up-to-date VAT reporting. This contributes to compliance with local tax regulations.

Feature.Title: Save time with automatic account codes
Feature.description: Save time by using automatic account codes. This feature streamlines the bookkeeping process and reduces manual entry, improving the efficiency of your accounting.

Feature.Title: Swedish localization delivered as extension
Feature.description: The Swedish localization is now delivered as an extension, which provides greater flexibility and easier implementation. This supports Swedish companies with specific legislative requirements.

Feature.Title: Supporting more countries and regions
Feature.description: This update includes support for more countries/regions, making Business Central available to an even wider global audience. It helps companies to operate in new markets.

Feature.Title: AL Explorer and AL Home in Visual Studio Code AL extension
Feature.description: AL Explorer and AL Home are now integrated into the Visual Studio Code AL extension, providing developers with a more comprehensive and user-friendly environment for AL development. This significantly improves productivity.

Feature.Title: Better InStream support
Feature.description: There is now better InStream support, improving the handling of data streams in Business Central. This optimizes the performance and stability of integrations and data transfers.

Feature.Title: Code action for removing ApplicationArea on fields when same as page level
Feature.description: A new code action allows removing the ApplicationArea on fields when it matches the page level. This streamlines the code base and improves efficiency for developers.

Feature.Title: Code navigability on event subscribers
Feature.description: Code navigability on event subscribers is improved, making it easier for developers to trace and understand code flow. This contributes to faster troubleshooting and development.

Feature.Title: Control database locking behavior
Feature.description: You can now control database locking behavior, giving greater control over database performance and resource utilization. This is important to optimize the response and stability of the application.

Feature.Title: Define regional settings per report using a region property
Feature.description: It is now possible to define regional settings per report using a dedicated region property. This ensures correct formatting of dates, numbers and currencies according to local standards.

Feature.Title: Developers can write faster install code
Feature.description: Developers can now write faster installation code, reducing the time it takes to install and update extensions. This improves the development process and shortens implementation times.

Feature.Title: Folder paths for control add-in resources
Feature.description: There are now folder paths for controlling add-on resources, providing better organization and management of resources. This improves the development workflow and ensures a more structured approach.

Feature.Title: Go to implementation for interfaces
Feature.description: Go to implementation for interfaces is now possible, improving code navigation. This makes it easier for developers to understand and maintain complex AL applications.

Feature.Title: Improved compiler resource handling and faster code analyzers
Feature.description: Compiler resource management has been improved and code analyzers have become faster. This results in a more efficient and faster development process, saving time for developers.

Feature.Title: IntelliSense indicator for temporary tables
Feature.description: An IntelliSense indicator is now available for temporary tables, improving developer productivity. This allows for faster and more accurate code completion and debugging.

Feature.Title: IntelliSense suggestion for enum ordinal value
Feature.description: IntelliSense now suggests enum ordinal values, simplifying code development. This reduces errors and speeds up the coding process for developers.

Feature.Title: Iterating with foreach on Text variables
Feature.description: You can now iterate with foreach on text variables, giving more flexibility in AL programming. This simplifies handling of text data and improves code efficiency.

Feature.Title: New rule to enforce pragma warning specifying a disabled rule
Feature.description: A new rule enforces pragma warnings that indicate a disabled rule, improving code quality and compliance with coding standards. This helps developers write more robust code.

Feature.Title: New telemetry events from validating uploaded PTEs
Feature.description: There are new telemetry events from validating uploaded PTEs, providing better insight into extension performance. This helps developers identify and fix potential problems faster.

Feature.Title: Provide Title and custom actions to Error dialogs
Feature.description: You can now specify title and custom actions for error dialogs, improving the error handling user experience. This makes error messages more informative and actionable.

Feature.Title: Publishers can use existing custom licensing while moving to AppSource transactability
Feature.description: Publishers can now use existing custom licenses when transitioning to AppSource tradability. This simplifies the process for publishing apps and ensures continuity in licensing models.

Feature.Title: Support for multiple .al package cache paths for symbols
Feature.description: There is now support for more .al package cache paths for symbols, providing more flexibility in the development environment. This improves the efficiency and performance of AL development.

Feature.Title: Support for overriding the PublicWebBaseURL server setting on-premises
Feature.description: There is now support for overriding the PublicWebBaseURL server setting in local environments. This provides greater control and flexibility in the configuration of on-premise installations.

Feature.Title: URLs in includeRuleSets
Feature.description: URL addresses can now be included in includeRuleSets, providing more flexibility in handling rules. This is useful for defining and managing external resources in your AL projects.

Feature.Title: Deploy hotfixes for older AppSource apps
Feature.description: It is now possible to roll out patches to older AppSource apps, ensuring that older versions remain stable and up-to-date. This improves maintainability and longevity of your apps.

Feature.Title: AL-Go for GitHub modern DevOps for partners
Feature.description: AL-Go for GitHub offers modern DevOps functionality to partners, streamlining development and deployment processes. This promotes effective collaboration and automation in software development.

Feature.Title: Attach AL debugger to active session or next session
Feature.description: You can now attach the AL debugger to an active session or to the next session for a specific user. This improves the debugging process and provides greater control over debugging code.

Feature.Title: Feature Management updates for 2023 release wave 1
Feature.description: Feature management updates have arrived in release wave 1 for 2023, giving administrators better control over new features. This makes it easier to manage and implement new features step by step.

Feature.Title: Delegated adminâs job queue entries are run by user
Feature.description: Deputy Administrator job queues are now run by the user, improving the traceability and security of administrative tasks. This ensures a clear division of responsibility for automated processes.

Feature.Title: Get an improved cloud migration status overview
Feature.description: You get an improved overview of the status of cloud migration, which makes it easier to follow and manage the migration process. This provides greater transparency and control over migration to the cloud.

Feature.Title: Manage user permissions using security groups
Feature.description: Manage user permissions more efficiently using security groups. This simplifies the assignment of rights and ensures that users only have access to the necessary functions and data.

Feature.Title: Get telemetry on cloud migration setup and replication runs
Feature.description: Access telemetry on cloud migration and replication setup, providing deeper insight into process performance. This helps optimize and debug migration and replication workflows.

Feature.Title: Migrate more companies per replication run
Feature.description: You can now migrate several companies per replication run, speeding up the migration process. This is especially useful for larger deployments and consolidations of data.

Feature.Title: Audit file export eases SAF-T compliance
Feature.description: Exporting audit files is now easier, supporting SAF-T compliance. This simplifies the process of generating audit reports and ensures you meet regulatory requirements.

Feature.Title: Non-deductible, partly deductible VAT expands functionality
Feature.description: The functionality for non-deductible and partially deductible VAT has been expanded. This provides greater accuracy in VAT accounting and ensures compliance with complex VAT rules.

Feature.Title: Create engaging partner-specific trial and onboarding experiences
Feature.description: Create engaging and partner-specific trial and onboarding experiences. This helps attract new customers and ensures they quickly get started using Business Central effectively.

Feature.Title: Experience enhanced adaptive cards in Teams
Feature.description: Experience improved adaptive maps in Teams, enriching communication and collaboration. This allows you to interact with Business Central data directly from Teams.

Feature.Title: Configure security controls for Teams cards
Feature.description: Set up security controls for Teams cards, allowing you to control access to sensitive data. This ensures that information is shared securely and only with authorized users.

Feature.Title: Easily set up access with Microsoft 365 licenses
Feature.description: Easily set up access with your existing Microsoft 365 licenses. This simplifies user management and integration between Business Central and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem.

Feature.Title: Analyze, group, and pivot data on list pages using multiple tabs
Feature.description: You can now analyze, group, and pivot data directly on list pages using multiple tabs. This gives you flexible and advanced options for data analysis without exporting data.

Feature.Title: Allow application and tenant databases to differ in collation
Feature.description: This feature allows application and tenant databases to have different collations. This provides greater flexibility in the database structure and supports different regional settings.

Feature.Title: Business Central server runs on .NET 6
Feature.description: Business Central Server now runs on .NET 6, improving performance and security. This update provides a more robust and modern platform for your Business Central solution.

Feature.Title: Control max time a task can run on the service
Feature.description: You can now control the maximum time a task can run on the service. This helps prevent long-running processes from affecting performance and ensures more stable operation.

Feature.Title: New telemetry events and data
Feature.description: New telemetry events and data are available, providing deeper insight into system performance and usage. This is essential for monitoring and optimizing your Business Central installation.

Feature.Title: Performance - OData calls are now faster
Feature.description: The performance of OData calls has been improved, resulting in faster data exchange. This optimizes integrations with external systems and improves overall system responsiveness.

Feature.Title: Performance - Opening pages is faster
Feature.description: Performance has been improved, so opening pages is now faster. This provides a more responsive and fluid user experience, increasing productivity for all users.

Feature.Title: Search in company data
Feature.description: You can now search directly in company data, making it quick and easy to find specific information. This feature improves data availability and efficiency in your daily operations.

Feature.Title: Drag and drop files onto the file upload dialog
Feature.description: It is now possible to drag and drop files directly into the File Upload dialog box, simplifying the process of uploading documents. This improves usability and saves time.

Feature.Title: Access actions and navigation menu efficiently with keyboard
Feature.description: Access actions and the navigation menu efficiently using the keyboard. This improves productivity for power users and those who prefer keyboard shortcuts.

Feature.Title: Get more productivity out of an optimized Action Bar on all app pages
Feature.description: An optimized action bar on all app pages gives you more productivity. This streamlines access to important functions and makes your workflow more efficient and intuitive.

Feature.Title: Tailor the action bar to fit your needs on document lines
Feature.description: You can now customize the action bar on document lines to suit your specific needs. This provides greater flexibility and a more personalized user experience that optimizes your workflow.

Feature.Title: Improved alignment of headers in statistics pages
Feature.description: The alignment of headers on statistics pages has been improved, giving a cleaner and more professional look. This makes it easier to read and understand your statistical data.

Feature.Title: Fix errors yourself with actionable error messages
Feature.description: You can now fix errors yourself with actionable error messages that guide you to a solution. This reduces the need for support and allows you to get on with your work faster.
